notes:
## New features & enhancements

- **The app draws its own tooltips.** They appear on keyboard focus as well as on hover, which the browser's never did, and they wear the same neutral plate as the Settings drawer rather than changing with each face. Escape dismisses one.
- The mini radio unpins on **Escape**, and its expand icon is a little bolder.
- The read me opens larger, at 1000x1000, and has a **search box**: type three characters and pick a section to jump to.
- Settings → Updates now names the **Deskside Radio - Update** Start menu entry, and says the installer reports which version it is putting down and which it replaces.

## Bug fixes

- **8-bit:** the meter's colour boundaries fell mid-LED, so one lamp was painted half green and half amber. They now snap to whole cells.
- **8-bit:** the volume and tone sliders lit one LED and part of its neighbour, because the cell mask was on the control and clipped the knob along with the track. The knob is now a solid block on a masked track.
- **8-bit:** the schedule chip was shorter than the buttons beside it.
- The fader stuttered visibly through a scheduled fade: the fade ran on a 40ms timer and wrote whole numbers into a control whose steps are two pixels apart. It now runs on the frame clock and can stand between them.
- The mini radio's fader sat still through a handover instead of riding the fade with the radio's own.
